name: Spawned Horror
body:
NE tiny aberration (akashic, evil)
Init —; Senses low-light vision, darkvision 60 ft., Perception +0

DEFENSE

AC 15, touch 15, flat-footed 12 (+3 Dex, +2 size)
hp 3 (1d8-1)
Immune mind-affecting, sleep
Fort –1, Ref +5, Will +2

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee bite +2 + creator’s veilweaver level + creator’s veilweaving modifier (1d4+0)
Space 2-1/2 ft.; Reach 5 ft.

STATISTICS

Str 10, Dex 16, Con 8, Int 12, Wis 10, Cha 11
Base Atk +0; CMB –2; CMD 11 (15 vs trip)
Feats Lightning Reflexes
Skills Acrobatics +7, Climb +7, Fly +11, Swim +7, Stealth +15; Racial Modifiers +4 Fly, +8 Stealth
Languages Cannot speak, but understands the languages of their creator

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Bite (Ex)

Spawned horrors are intrinsically linked to the veilweaver who spawned them. They use their creator’s veilweaving level as their base attack bonus for their bite, and their creator’s veilweaving modifier in place of their Strength bonus when determining their attack rolls. Being tiny creatures, they also get a +2 bonus to their attack roll due to their size.
